---
title: "Concept explorer"
---

```{r setup}
source("_common.R")
concept_units <- targets::tar_read(concept_units, store = store)
seeds <- targets::tar_read(seeds, store = store)
```

Concepts are found with **reviewable seed patterns**
([`concept_seeds.csv`](https://github.com/EDIorg/Units-WG/blob/agentic/eml_corpus_analysis/data/reference/concept_seeds.csv))
over attribute names, labels, and definitions. An attribute may match several
concepts. Seeds are a transparent first pass. Their precision is checked in
the audit (see [Classification](classification.qmd)), and known noise is
recorded in each seed's `notes`.

## Concepts overview

`dimension_vectors` is the number of distinct QUDT DimensionVectors across
the concept's units. A value above 1 means one QK cannot cover the concept.

```{r overview}
interactive_table(
  concept_units$overview |>
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(seeds, concept, label), by = "concept") |>
    dplyr::relocate(label, .after = concept) |>
    dplyr::mutate(share_qudt_mapped = round(share_qudt_mapped, 3)),
  "concept_overview",
  columns = list(top_units = wide(360))
)
```

```{r spread}
plotly::plot_ly(
  concept_units$overview,
  x = ~datasets, y = ~dimension_vectors, text = ~concept, size = ~unit_groups,
  type = "scatter", mode = "markers", hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  plotly::layout(
    title = "Concepts: usage vs. spread across dimension vectors",
    xaxis = list(title = "Datasets", type = "log"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Dimension vectors")
  )
```

## Concept × dimension vector

Each row is a candidate *commensurable family* for a concept. These rows are
the unit of analysis for QK admission (see [QK modeling](modeling.qmd)).

```{r by-dimension}
shared_dv <- crosstalk::SharedData$new(concept_units$by_dimension)
filtered_table(
  crosstalk::filter_select("concept_dv", "Concept", shared_dv, ~concept),
  reactable::reactable(
    shared_dv,
    searchable = TRUE, compact = TRUE, striped = TRUE, resizable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 15, columns = list(top_units = wide(360))
  )
)
```

## Concept × unit

```{r by-unit}
shared_unit <- crosstalk::SharedData$new(concept_units$by_unit)
filtered_table(
  list(
    crosstalk::filter_select("concept_u", "Concept", shared_unit, ~concept),
    crosstalk::filter_select("dv_u", "Dimension vector", shared_unit, ~dimension_vector)
  ),
  reactable::reactable(
    shared_unit,
    searchable = TRUE, compact = TRUE, striped = TRUE, resizable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 15, columns = list(top_names = wide(260))
  )
)
```

## Seed patterns

```{r seeds}
interactive_table(
  seeds, "concept_seeds",
  columns = list(include_pattern = wide(280), exclude_pattern = wide(200), notes = wide(240))
)
```
